cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageRack to store boxes and trays which have their own floor
Drawers are not included:
![Inside](static/samples/StorageRack-2.jpg) ![Back wall details](static/samples/StorageRack-3.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageRack --x 120 --depth 250 --sh 60:80:100 --rail 40 --outside 1 --bottom_edge s --top_edge S --Stackable_height 2.5 --thickness 5 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageRack --x --depth --sh --rail --bottom_edge --top_edge --Stackable_height --thickness --burn --reference --labels
